PC07-002.name: The Bond with Buddy
PC07-002.effect:
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "Mugen", this card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects, and if it's the opposing Attack Step, it becomes Cost 4.

[Flash]
During this turn, every opposing Cost 4 or more Spirit/Ultimate can't attack. Also, if you control any Ultimate, and your Life is at five or less, put a core from the Void to your Life. Then, banish this card.

PC07-001.name: The Infinite Power
PC07-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Mugen", your counters +2. Then, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add an Ultimate card among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom. If you have four counters or more, you can add +1 card to Hand via this effect.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 6 or more Ultimate attacks, you can destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.
